tests.scope: This exact frozen runtime source; predecessor tests are not reused.

method.reference: source-clock interpolation to next_command, then zero request at0.5s
method.execution_K: Coordinator log-K lag tau0.5s, cap0.05/tick, continues while workers are busy; one sample frozen during each complete IK calculation.
method.optimizer: Complete Gaussian/Bingham-mixture normalized J with existing s condition; eight backtracks and same-J/s feasible interior repair.

physical_pose_accuracy.covariance_width_definition: 3*sqrt(trace(P)), a diagnostic Euclidean width; anisotropic Gaussian proxy coverage uses support-aware Mahalanobis chi-square95

single_update_full_J.scope: Every single-update full gradient/trial/normalizer/mixture term and exact position constraint independently reconstructed, including the strict-interior cone and actual source/candidate identity. No future IK rollout.

single_update_execution.scope: One selected endpoint, original source-clock interpolation and expiry, unscaled reference-position tracking, and ordinary actuator bounds independently recomputed. No future rollout and no call to the runtime command helper or IK/inference.

execution_K.scope: 20 Hz filter recurrence independently recomputed; unchanged full estimated records/density/proposals; request samples frozen with IK, same epoch actual ledger, deterministic auxiliary mechanics, and actual historical next-prior/catchup replay. Filter signal is not a posterior.

K_representative.scope: recorded full continuous density and score restored, every bounded representative step checked, unchanged estimated K traced separately from the applied K into IK and actual command ledger; no true stiffness input

visible_hold_policy.scope: actual adopted raw-preview index and timestamp, same fused goal and committed IK source, exact bounded local command intervals, stopped post-stop-observation resume; no physical truth input

physical_execution_supplement.reversal_definition: Adjacent opposite-sign velocities with both magnitudes >1e-6 rad/s; an intervening zero tick is not counted.
physical_execution_supplement.adjacent_reference_difference_definition: Difference to the preceding tick reference at a plan-source change; includes elapsed reference progress and is not a same-time continuity proof.
limitations: The asynchronous runs do not share an identical sequence of observations/availability times, commands or posterior densities; this comparison does not isolate the horizon as the only causal variable.
Velocity-reversal counts depend on task progress and observation changes, and are not a formal stability guarantee.
Hardware acceleration bounds may leave nonzero command velocity during a zero-velocity expiry request.
